title: Undefined focus token overrides the canonical keyboard outline
observedCorrection: The five-line local focus override was removed; current controls inherit the existing canonical globals.css outline. No shared style or controller/test changed.
evidence: The owned selectors .button:focus-visible and .field input:focus-visible set outline:2px solid var(--ring). No --ring definition exists in application/UI CSS. RootLayout imports globals.css, whose valid blue focus rules have lower specificity. An unresolved var invalidates the winning outline at computed-value time, resetting the noninherited outline to its initial value, not falling back to the earlier declaration.
impact: Keyboard buttons and inputs lose the intended visible focus outline when composed under current app styles. Inactive today; does not affect PR17 shipping source.
minimumCorrection: Remove the unnecessary owned outline override to inherit the canonical focus styles, or use an explicitly defined token/fallback. Do not edit shared UI or invent a global design token for this bounded correction.
futureVerification: At a leased browser gate, Tab through workflow buttons/title/date in current host styles and require an actual visible outline. Preserve native disabled state and pending/unknown fences.

title: An old approval refusal remains visible after a newer execution becomes uncertain
reproduction: Prepare proposal; execute returns approval-pending, setting approvalRefused=true; a separate service then grants approval; next deliberate execute dispatches but returns unknown/result-withheld/stored-withheld or throws. #fail sets blocked/problem but retains approvalRefused=true. ProposalPanel still says Current approval is still required next to the newer failure.
impact: Incorrect current-approval messaging from an earlier request. The unknown fence remains intact; this finding does not claim unauthorized execution or duplicate effects.
minimumCorrection: Retire the previous refusal when a new execute operation is actually admitted and do not carry it into a newer failure. Preserve pending refusal for its own response and synchronous duplicate request guards.
requiredRegression: Chained approval-pending -> external fixture approval -> held newer execution -> uncertain/withheld/thrown result. Verify stale flag is cleared, exact proposal handle is retained and unknown fence blocks further dispatch. Existing separate pending and unknown tests do not cover this sequence.
reviewerRuntime: Not executed; confirmed by source transition trace.
correction: #run retires old approvalRefused only after active/busy/problem admission for execute; #fail also clears it. A new approval-pending reply still records its own refusal.
regressionEvidence: Five unchanged chained cases fail before (21 pass/5 fail), pass after (26/26); assertions check both held and settled snapshots, same opaque handle, duplicate suppression, blocked retries and private error omission.
